status_definitions.data_blocked: Evidence exists, but one or more fail-closed experiment requirements are missing or unproven.
status_definitions.incomplete: Some declared cadence or required field evidence exists, but the declared capability surface is not complete.
status_definitions.stale: Bound evidence has a latest observation more than seven calendar days before the fixed audit date.
status_definitions.unavailable: No bound public-safe evidence establishes the capability for the instrument family.
status_definitions.usable: All data capabilities required by the frozen experiment are hash-bound, fresh, and available at decision time.
